high_level_description: The image depicts a person sitting on a boat, enjoying a sunny day on a body of water surrounded by lush green hills. The individual is wearing a black bikini with thin straps and a small pink bow at the front. They also have on a wide-brimmed hat with a patterned band, which appears to be leopard print, and sunglasses. The person has long blonde hair that flows down their back. The boat is white and appears to be a motorboat, as indicated by the visible motor at the back. The water is calm, reflecting the clear blue sky above.
